replies.author: Zedther
replies.body:
[Denied] I'm sorry to say your map has been denied, and will not be featured on the Avicus Network on the rotations as an active map.Your map was denied for the followed reasons
- Lack of Effort -The Map lacks effort and is rather simple, it is flat and does not have much makes it stand out.
-GamePlay Issues - There is a lack of borders around each quadrant with the exception of the sand walls, those though have a few holes. There is a large amount of ores, making gameplay much too easy.
